name: Broken Access Control
description: Failures in enforcing authorized access to resources and actions.

name: Security Misconfiguration
description: Insecure configuration of applications, platforms, services, or security controls.

name: Software Supply Chain Failures
description: Failures or compromises involving dependencies, build systems, repositories, and software distribution.

name: Cryptographic Failures
description: Failures to properly protect sensitive information through cryptography.

name: Injection
description: Untrusted input is interpreted as part of a command, query, or other executable structure.

name: Insecure Design
description: Security weaknesses caused by missing or inadequate security requirements and design controls.

name: Authentication Failures
description: Weaknesses in authentication mechanisms, identity verification, or session handling.

name: Software or Data Integrity Failures
description: Failures to verify the integrity of software, code, updates, or critical data.

name: Security Logging and Alerting Failures
description: Insufficient logging, monitoring, detection, and alerting of security-relevant events.

name: Mishandling of Exceptional Conditions
description: Improper handling of errors, unusual states, failures, and exceptional conditions.
